items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So I had occasion to record some bop music with Thelonius Monk... He yood Pancho did a vocal on one of them.

ctx.x: Yeah. So I had occasion to record some bop music with Thelonius Monk, which two of them I remember. One was "Mysterioso", and the other one was "Epistrophy". And we had a vocal on it. He yood Pancho did a vocal on one of them. I forget what it was. But it was out of his key and Monk made him sing it anyway. And Pancho's throat was sore for a week.

Couldn't get him to sing a note. He hurt himself. But at any rate, down through the years Monk has come into being more of a piano player, to the point whereas you can recognize what he's playing, you know, the melodic line. I heard him play "Just a Gigolo" as a solo. He could do it, but in little spots he would put Monk in there. Tink-tink-tink, you know. He would go off kilter for a minute, but he would come back to the melody, you know. But then, when I was working with him, there was never any melody. So Monk…
